image_description: A close-up, slightly angled view of a printed paper menu. The text is heavily distorted and illegible, resembling 'gibberish' or AI-generated hallucinations of characters rather than real language. There are columns of text with what appear to be prices on the right side. A green leafy garnish is visible in the top left corner, partially obscuring the menu header. The lighting is somewhat dim, casting shadows across the page.

artifact_observations.location: Throughout the entire text body of the menu
artifact_observations.reasoning: The primary function of a menu is readable text. The image contains completely nonsensical, malformed characters that do not belong to any known alphabet. This is a catastrophic failure for this class.
The green leafy object has a smeared, painterly texture that blends unnaturally into the background and the menu edge, lacking crisp botanical detail.
The lines of text wobble and curve inconsistently, not following a strict planar perspective grid as printed text on a flat or folded surface should.
